fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.subtitle: Prepare your moves and missions.
fleet.slots: Fleets in flight: {used}/{max} (the Computer technology adds one fleet per level)
fleet.expeditionHelp: Sends the fleet into deep space (position 16 of the system): it sometimes finds resources or ships, but may also be delayed, attacked by pirates or swallowed by a black hole. Expedition technology required; the report arrives on landing in the Reports page.
fleet.holdHelp: Hold position at an ally: the fleet stays in orbit of their planet or moon (up to 32 h), defends it if attacked, then returns. Holding fuel (a tenth of consumption per hour) is paid up front; the host's alliance depot can refund it. Target: a member of your alliance.
fleet.acsHelp: Strike a target at the same moment as your alliance members: pick a group already announced for these coordinates (you arrive with it, if your fleet is fast enough) or create a new one.

galaxy.title: Galaxy
galaxy.subtitle: Navigate the universe and spot available systems.

messages.title: Messages
messages.subtitle: Manage your communications with other commanders.
messages.emptyHint: Send a message to start a conversation.
messages.selectHint: Select a message to read it.

alliance.title: Alliance
alliance.subtitle: Create or join an alliance to progress together.
alliance.joinHint: Enter the alliance id received by message.
alliance.leaveHint: You will leave the alliance immediately.
alliance.leaveBlocked: The founder cannot leave without dissolving.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.subtitle: Server configuration and supervision.
admin.roleHint: Promote a player or adjust permissions.
admin.boostHint: Set all buildings and technologies to level 100.
admin.moderationHint: Ban or unban a player quickly.
admin.applyProfileHint: Fills speeds, multipliers and base income; review, then save.
admin.banDurationHint: Ban duration. Days, hours and minutes add up. All zero = permanent ban.
admin.serverLanguageHint: Default language of the game, the interface and the emails (chosen at installation). Each player can then choose their own.

playersPanel.title: Players
playersPanel.searchPlaceholder: All players or part of a username

actions.resetDone: Progress reset. The player was logged out and can start again with the same access.
actions.title: Account management
actions.restricted: Actions are reserved for accounts ranked below yours. Your own account is protected.
actions.resetWarning: This action is irreversible. Colonies, buildings, research, ships, defences and queues are erased. The main planet restarts with 500 metal and 500 crystal. Access, role, ban, alliance and messages are kept. The player is logged out.
actions.deleteWarning: Permanent deletion of the account, its planets, resources, units, research, messages and reports. The player will be logged out.
actions.fleetsWarning: The player's active fleets, or fleets heading to their planets, must finish or be recalled before this action. To delete an alliance founder, first transfer the founding or dissolve the alliance.

profile.emailHint: The change logs the player out and sends a new link. Login stays blocked until the new address is confirmed.
profile.emailChange: Change the email and send verification

smtp.loadError: Unable to load the SMTP configuration.
smtp.title: Configure SMTP
smtp.intro: Server used to send the game's emails (verification, forgotten password). Only the super admin can change these settings; the password is encrypted in the database and never displayed.
smtp.secure: Direct TLS connection (port 465) — leave unticked for STARTTLS (port 587)
smtp.passwordUnreadable: The stored password is unreadable (encryption key changed): enter it again.
smtp.testHint: Uses the saved configuration. Without a recipient, the message is sent to your own address.

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.subtitle: Recommended steps to launch your empire.
onboarding.finishedBody: Your infrastructure, research and first fleet are in place. Grow your mines, colonize and explore the galaxy.

solar_plant.title: Build a Solar Plant
solar_plant.hint: Mines consume energy. Without it they run at reduced output.

metal_mine.title: Build a Metal Mine
metal_mine.hint: Metal is the base of every construction.

crystal_mine.title: Build a Crystal Mine
crystal_mine.hint: Crystal is needed for the laboratory, research and ships.

deuterium_mine.title: Build a Deuterium Synthesizer
deuterium_mine.hint: Deuterium fuels fleets and is required by the laboratory and most research.

energy_balance.title: Balance your energy
energy_balance.hint: When mines need more energy than the plant supplies, their output drops. Upgrade the Solar Plant until production reaches 100%.

research_lab.title: Build the Research Laboratory
research_lab.hint: It unlocks technologies and costs deuterium: keep your Deuterium Synthesizer running.

first_research.title: Start your first research
first_research.hint: Energy Technology is a good first choice: it opens most other technologies.

first_ship.title: Build your first ship
first_ship.hint: Check the requirements shown on each ship card; some need a research first.

first_mission.title: Send your first fleet
first_mission.hint: Transport, espionage or deployment: pick a mission on the Fleet page.

mission_report.title: Read a mission result
mission_report.hint: Reports summarize the outcome of espionage and combat missions.

energy.title: How energy works
energy.body: Mines consume the energy produced by Solar Plants. If consumption exceeds production, every mine slows down proportionally. Keep production at 100%.

buildings.title: Buildings
buildings.body: Costs are spent when you start and grow with each level. The number of simultaneous constructions is limited. Plan around your scarcest resource, often deuterium.

research.title: Research
research.body: A technology needs a laboratory level and sometimes other technologies. Only one research runs at a time; the cost is paid up front.

shipyard.title: Shipyard
shipyard.body: Ships need a Shipyard and often a research. Check the requirements on each card. Orders are paid immediately and built in batches.

fleet.title: Fleet missions
fleet.body: Choose ships, a target and a mission. Fuel (deuterium) is consumed on departure. Transport and deployment deliver resources; espionage needs probes; colonization needs a colony ship.

shipyard.title: Shipyard
shipyard.subtitle: Build and deploy your ships to dominate the galaxy

defense.title: Defense
defense.subtitle: Defenses fight alongside the stationed fleet; after a battle, each destroyed defense is repaired with a 70% chance.

buildings.subtitle: Build and upgrade your planet’s infrastructure
buildings.queueEmptyHint: Select a building to start construction
buildings.selectPlanet: Select a planet to view its buildings.

effects.maxLevel: Maximum level reached: no further upgrade.
effects.seeDescription: See the description and costs of this upgrade.
effects.lowEnergy: Not enough energy: the actual production of the mines will be reduced.
effects.forecast: Forecast with the planet's current levels and the server multipliers. Actual production depends on the energy efficiency.
effects.durationNote: Duration reduction at identical cost, before rounding and the one-second minimum. Constructions and research already started keep their duration.

queue.refundNotice: Refund: 90% of the resources paid. The remaining 10% is lost.
queue.title: Shipyard queue · {active} in production · {waiting} waiting
queue.note: Resources are debited when you order. Withdrawing a waiting order refunds 90%. Batches already started finish normally.

research.title: Technologies
research.subtitle: Unlock strategic advantages for your fleets and infrastructure.
research.hoverHint: Hover over a technology to see its requirements.
research.labNetwork: Research network (level {level}): effective lab {effective} = local lab {own} + {linked} linked lab(s) from your other planets. Research times take it into account.

commander.levelTitle: The commander level depends on buildings and research.
commander.powerTitle: Current power: buildings, research, ships, defenses and colonies.
commander.perPlanet: Per planet: {buildings} simultaneous building(s) · {lines} production line(s).
commander.slotsNote: The Construction Management and Parallel Production researches unlock 2 slots; with commander level 50, up to 3 slots.
commander.breakdownNote: The commander depends only on buildings and research. Stockpiles and unproduced orders do not count.

planetScene.hint: Click the planet to quickly reach buildings and strategic management.

report.moonCreated: The battle left a moon behind!
report.participantsNote: The loot shown is the group's; each fleet brings back a share proportional to its free capacity.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: History of battles and recent results.
reports.emptyHint: Launch an attack to generate your first report.
reports.spyEmpty: No espionage report. Send probes from the Fleet page.
reports.expEmpty: No finished expedition. Send a fleet to position 16 from the Fleet page.
reports.exp_nothing: Nothing of interest was found; the fleet returns.
reports.exp_speedup: A favourable current shortens the return (×{factor}).
reports.exp_blackhole: A black hole swallowed the whole fleet.

spy.fleetHidden: Fleet not revealed: send more probes or improve your Espionage technology.

account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
account.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

language.title: Installation language
language.hint: It becomes the default language of the game, the server and the emails. Each player can then choose their own.

done.title: Installation complete.
done.notice: The super admin account is confirmed and the installation wizard is now locked for good. It can only be reopened from a terminal on the server.

code.intro: To protect the server, installation is reserved for the person with access to its terminal. Read the installation code in the API log:
code.regenerateSuffix: (from the project folder on the server).
code.label: Installation code

smtp.intro: Email sending server (account confirmation, forgotten password). It is also used to validate your account at the end of the installation.
smtp.secure: Direct TLS connection (port 465) — untick for STARTTLS (port 587)
smtp.saved: Configuration saved. Now send a test email.
smtp.testSent: Test email sent to {to}. Check that it arrived before continuing.

settings.intro: Universe settings. They can still be changed later from the administration; keep the defaults if in doubt.
settings.profileHint: ×50 speed, original costs: laboratory in 22 min, first ship in under 2 h.

gameSpeed.label: Game speed
gameSpeed.hint: Speeds up durations and production (1 = original pace)

admin.intro: Server super admin account. A confirmation link will be sent to this address: clicking it completes the installation. If the address is wrong, you can recreate the account as long as it is not confirmed.
admin.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter and a digit.
admin.submit: Create the account and send the link
admin.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

validation.sentTo: A confirmation email was sent to
validation.instructions: Click the link it contains: this page updates by itself and the installation completes as soon as the account is confirmed.
validation.fix: Fix the address or the account

supervision.intro: Choose how to track server errors. Local monitoring is always on and is enough; Sentry is an option you can also add later in the admin console.

supervision.title: Monitoring
supervision.localActive: Local monitoring is always on: incidents are kept on this server, with no external service.

code.timeout: No response within the time limit

settings.title: Monitoring settings
settings.superAdminOnly: Read-only: only the super admin can change these settings.

purge.title: Purge the local log
purge.hint: Permanently deletes old incidents. The action is recorded in the audit log.
purge.confirm: Permanently delete incidents older than {days} days?

mode.title: Monitoring mode
mode.localHint: Errors and server health stay on this server and can be viewed in the admin console. No external service required.
mode.sentryHint: Also sends errors to your Sentry account. The local log stays active even if Sentry is unavailable.

local.title: Local log
local.alwaysOn: Always on: it cannot be turned off.

sentry.title: Sentry (optional)
sentry.fromEnvironment: Sentry is configured by a server environment variable, which takes precedence over this page.
sentry.privacy: DSNs are encrypted on the server and never shown again. No Sentry API token is requested.
sentry.dsnKept: Saved ({hint}) — leave empty to keep it
sentry.dsnUnreadable: The saved DSN is unreadable (encryption key changed): enter it again.
sentry.dsnBrowserHint: Used to report errors seen in players’ browsers; applied without rebuilding.
sentry.clearConfirm: Remove the Sentry configuration? Local monitoring stays on.
sentry.cleared: Sentry configuration removed. Local monitoring stays on.
sentry.nonBlocking: This blocks nothing: the game and local monitoring carry on.

result.server_error: Sentry answered with a server error.
result.unreachable: Sentry cannot be reached from this server.
result.timeout: Sentry did not answer in time.

errors.dsnRequired: Enter the API DSN (or choose local monitoring only).

uptime.title: Availability
uptime.none: No measurement yet: one sample is recorded every minute.
uptime.hint: A minute without a measurement (server stopped, database unreachable) counts as unavailable. “Degraded” still counts as available. Project goal: 99%.

missiles.title: Interplanetary missiles
missiles.subtitle: The silo holds 10 missiles per level. An anti-ballistic missile shoots down one enemy missile; every interplanetary missile that gets through destroys defences on the target planet.
missiles.noSilo: Build a missile silo to store missiles.
missiles.noRange: Impulse Drive (level 1) is required to fire.
missiles.lost: Target gone: the missiles are lost.
missiles.incomingWarning: Missiles are approaching one of your planets!

moonOps.title: Moon
moonOps.subtitle: The sensor phalanx reveals fleet movements around a nearby planet; the jump gate moves ships from one moon to another instantly.
moonOps.selectMoon: Pick a moon in the planet selector to use the phalanx and the jump gate.
moonOps.phalanxMissing: Build a sensor phalanx (lunar base level 1 required).
moonOps.phalanxRange: Level {level}: range {range} systems around system {system} (galaxy {galaxy}). A scan costs {cost} deuterium from the moon.
moonOps.gateMissing: Build a jump gate (lunar base 1 and Hyperspace technology 7).
moonOps.gateNoDestination: You need another moon equipped with a jump gate.
moonOps.gateReady: Gate ready. After a jump both gates recharge for {seconds} s.

officers.title: Officers
officers.subtitle: Hire an officer once and for all ({cost} deuterium): its bonuses apply to your whole account.
officers.paidOn: The price is taken from the selected planet: {planet}.

descriptions.intendant: Runs your empire's energy and construction sites.
descriptions.admiral: Commands your fleets and sends more expeditions.
descriptions.technocrat: Speeds up research and strengthens espionage.

fleetCommanders.title: Fleet commanders
fleetCommanders.subtitle: Recruit up to {max} commanders ({cost} deuterium each) and assign one to a fleet when sending it: it earns experience in combat and strengthens the fleet.
fleetCommanders.paidOn: The price is taken from the selected planet: {planet}.
fleetCommanders.name: Commander name
fleetCommanders.empty: No commander yet. Recruit one, then pick it on the Fleet page before sending.
fleetCommanders.selectHint: A free commander strengthens the fleet (attack, defense, speed, cargo).

market.title: Market
market.subtitle: Trade resources with other players. The seller escrows the resource; every sale is taxed {tax} % (destroyed); an offer expires after {hours} h (escrow returned); at most {max} active offers.
market.planet: Payments and purchases use the selected planet: {planet}.
market.noHistory: No sale recorded for this pair.

admin.title: World events
admin.intro: An event gives a temporary bonus to every player. Nothing starts by itself unless you tick “Automatic” on a template: it is then launched when its period begins, once a year.
admin.remindersNone: No event to launch right now.
admin.autoHint: Unticked: you only get a reminder. Ticked: the event starts by itself when its period begins.
admin.confirmEnd: Stop this event now? The bonus ends immediately.
admin.customHint: Production bonus: 100% at most. Tax reduction: 100% at most (100% = no tax).

quests.title: Quests
quests.subtitle: Three quests a day and two a week, counted from your real activity. Rewards are multiplied by {multiplier} (commander level {level}).
quests.planet: Rewards are credited to the selected planet: {planet}.

pending.title: Rewards to claim ({count})
pending.hint: Quests completed before a reset and never claimed: they are not lost. Daily quests stay claimable for 30 days, weekly quests for 12 weeks.

metric.groupAttacks: Take part in a group attack
